findings.claim: 經查 FY2025 10-K Item 3，公司僅提及 Note 9 的股東訴訟，其他日常法律程序預期不會對財務有重大不利影響；未揭露反壟斷調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3. Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: We are involved in various legal proceedings arising in the normal course of business. Although the outcomes of these legal proceedings are inherently difficult to predict, we do not expect the resolution of these legal proceedings to have a material adverse effect on our financial position, results of operations, or cash flows.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素列出加密資產監管動向（SEC 成立 Crypto Task Force 等），屬產業特定監管不確定性，非針對公司的反壟斷案。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: in January 2025, the SEC announced the formation of a “Crypto Task Force,” which is intended to provide clarity on the application of the federal securities laws to the crypto asset market and to recommend policy measures with respect to digital asset security status, registration and listing of digital asset-based investment vehicles, and digital asset custody, lending and staking;

findings.claim: Rosen Law Firm 於 2026-06-24 對 Strategy 及 Saylor 展開證券調查（原告律所調查，非政府行動，未提起集體訴訟）；三項搜尋均未找到 DOJ/FTC/EU 反壟斷調查。
findings.source: Bitcoin.com, Law Firm Investigates Strategy as MSTR Drops 7% and STRC Crashes to $73
